clauses.evidence: [activate [0] from battlefield]: card becomes tapped; 'you: mana U-1 W-1' (two mana, one blue). Tree: CostManaColor U + CostManaGeneric 1 + CostTap. No timing restriction.
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority, so the instant-speed ability is used only in its controller's action window

clauses.clause: Draw a card, then discard a card.
clauses.evidence: Every variant: 'you:Library 5#1 moves library -> hand (by card/DRAW)' first, then 'ask one_of: [you_spare, you_trick, you_land_drop, you_cast_spell, you_cast_creature, you:Library 5#1]' (your whole hand, the drawn card included, no skip option) and the chosen card moves hand -> graveyard; library 6 -> 5. The controller chooses (six variants, one per card).
clauses.issue: The discard is a hand-to-graveyard MOVE_ZONE without journal_kind 'DISCARD' (same as the compiler's canonical parse); no M21 card has a 'whenever you discard' trigger, so there is no effect in this set (M20 Bag of Holding would care).
